name: After § 15
title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 15a. Calls for the urgent protection of European SMEs against the dominance of non-EU digital giants; stresses the need to take measures that preserve digital sovereignty, prevent market killer acquisitions and ensure a level playing field for European innovation actors; insists on the necessity of preserving the proper distribution of competences between national authorities and the Commission, and denounces the expansive interpretation of the treaties and regulations;
